facts.text: Hightower takes two, then flips Copeland's car.
facts.why: Copeland's own car is wrecked in the driving lesson with Mahoney. Hightower later flips a police cruiser with Copeland inside.
facts.fix: Hightower takes two, then flips the cruiser with Copeland in it.
